status: criteria only; actual CI audit results are recorded separately in browser-evidence.json

acceptance_gates.completed_ci: execution status passed; actual Node/React/Playwright/managed Chromium versions from captured logs; 81 Node tests pass with 0 failures
acceptance_gates.five_profiles: counter, form, list, effect, list-growth; 43 trace ticks total; all four-way checks matched; 89 mutation controls
acceptance_gates.no_wasm: per-profile browser API attempts and .wasm requests are empty; page error arrays are empty
acceptance_gates.mounted_dom_and_controls: per-profile live DOM/control observations match expected trees after actions; checked, disabled, text values and action target values reflect mounted browser behavior
acceptance_gates.literal_vs_bound_action: preserve requested action intent, actual target/button value, lower-camel renderer Action and uppercase GoMessage as separate observations
acceptance_gates.keyed_focus: list input retains same keyed node after reorder; active target remains focused before/immediately/settled with selection start 0, end 2, direction backward
acceptance_gates.detached_callback: callback retained from removed node produces one stale observation and no message or dispatch increment
acceptance_gates.effect_lifecycle: pending view and physically disabled Request button are visible before correlated completion; one completion applies; duplicate is rejected without another tick
acceptance_gates.unmount: physical mounted root and renderer snapshot are both empty after unmount for each profile

provenance_gates.workflow_head_tree_parent: must match the assigned CI2 head/tree/parent
provenance_gates.execution_source_pins: verify recorded before/after pins and compare the captured browser/direct inputs against current exact-head source
provenance_gates.artifact_hashes: verify the root-announced archive digest and extraction manifest; do not redownload or inspect another provider directory

limits_to_record: Do not use prior local explicit-browser output as fresh-CI evidence.
Do not infer app browser behavior if Node tests, compile-four, or browser replay was not reached.
Retained callback after runtime unmount remains untested unless the captured CI artifact explicitly establishes it.
